epics.title: Personal AI Regulatory Assistant & GOST Order Generator
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident needs regulatory guidance or administrative drafts, I want an AI assistant grounded in institutional knowledge and a one-click GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx order generator, so that official administrative tasks are executed accurately in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Document generation turnaround under 3000ms with >= 99.5% template and GOST formatting fidelity
epics.tocConstraintRef: AI agent multi-format document synthesis latency and context retrieval bottleneck
requirements: R1: Universal Autonomous Document Agent Engine dynamically synthesizing official institutional documentation (orders, directives, UMS/GEK minutes, individual study plans, extracts, internal memos, analytical notes) without rigid template locks
R2: Multi-format document compilation and export supporting DOCX, PDF, XLSX, and CSV with strict typographical, numerical, and GOST R 7.0.97-2016 formatting compliance
R3: Dynamic context retrieval pipeline fusing knowledge base normative documents with academic entity relationship graph data to ground generated drafts in authentic institutional facts

R4: Bidirectional document provenance and association binding each generated document and analytical dossier directly to academic entity cards (postgraduates, residents, supervisors, departments, commissions)
R5: Interactive frontend agent interface allowing parameter adjustment, real-time draft preview, format selection, entity linking inspection, and one-click export with instant audit status

R6: End-to-end verification and test pyramid suite covering unit tests for synthesis prompt assembly and parsing, integration tests for multi-format export and entity binding, and E2E workflow tests for the entire generation journey

slices.title: Universal Document Generation API Contract & DTO Schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing the autonomous document workflow agent for this epic, I want to define the shared OpenAPI contracts, parameter schemas, and format export DTOs, so that frontend preview components and backend synthesis services build against an invariant type specification.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document generation request payload with target document type, dynamic prompt parameters, and entity reference IDs, When validated against the OpenAPI specification, Then the schema strictly enforces permitted export formats (DOCX, PDF, XLSX, CSV) and validates entity association identifiers.
Given an invalid or unsupported document target format, When the contract validation executes, Then a structured 400 Bad Request error response detailing schema violations is returned.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Shared contract definition synchronizing frontend document builder with backend synthesis endpoints
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% schema validation compliance across all defined document types and export variants

slices.title: Document Metadata, Provenance Record & Entity Binding Schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing persistent storage for generated institutional documents in this epic, I want to design database entities and repositories capturing generated document artifacts, SHA-256 provenance hashes, generation parameters, and bidirectional entity relationships, so that every document is traceably indexed and linked to academic entity cards.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated document record with author, timestamp, source knowledge base references, and target entity IDs, When persisted into the document repository, Then a unique UUID and SHA-256 integrity checksum are recorded along with foreign keys to linked postgraduate or departmental entities.
Given an academic entity ID query, When looking up associated documents, Then all generated orders, individual plans, extracts, and analytical dossiers linked to that entity are returned in reverse chronological order with pagination.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Entity document linkage index throughput and integrity verification speed
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero orphaned document records and sub-15ms entity document lookup latency

slices.title: Autonomous RAG Context Retrieval & Knowledge Graph Aggregator
slices.jtbd: When preparing generation context for the AI agent in this epic, I want to build a contextual retrieval service that queries the normative inverted index and navigates entity relationships in the academic graph, so that the language model receives exhaustive, hallucination-free facts prior to drafting.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrator initiating generation of a commission protocol or resident individual plan, When the aggregator resolves context, Then relevant normative excerpts, curriculum requirements, and student academic standing are bundled into a structured prompt context within 350ms.
Given an entity with missing or partial graph metadata, When context compilation executes, Then the service logs a non-fatal warning, applies safe academic defaults, and continues without system crash.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Normative search and entity graph traversal latency during context preparation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Context recall precision >= 98% and retrieval p95 latency under 500ms

slices.title: Autonomous Agent Multi-Format Synthesis & Exporter Engine
slices.jtbd: When producing official documents in this epic, I want to implement the core autonomous synthesis service and multi-format renderer emitting GOST-compliant DOCX, accessible PDF, structured XLSX, and CSV tables, so that arbitrary institutional documents and contingent reports are generated with high typographical and numerical fidelity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a synthesis prompt populated with normative context and academic entity details, When generating an official administrative order or protocol, Then the output is rendered as a GOST R 7.0.97-2016 compliant DOCX and PDF document including requisite signature blocks, seals, and typography.
Given a request for contingent progress or workload analytical tables, When the export engine executes, Then formatted XLSX and CSV files with valid headers, calculated totals, and sanitized data are produced within 2500ms.
slices.tocConstraintRef: LLM document synthesis throughput and multi-format binary rendering bottleneck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Document generation error rate < 0.1% and formatting standard adherence >= 99%

slices.title: Interactive Document Workflow Agent Panel & Entity Binding UI
slices.jtbd: When an administrator or instructor interacts with the AI assistant in this epic, I want a responsive, accessible browser interface featuring prompt controls, format selectors, real-time draft inspection, entity card linkage badges, and one-click export, so that users can seamlessly orchestrate document workflows on desktop and mobile.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an administrator navigating to the document generation workspace, When selecting a document category and target academic entity, Then the UI displays contextual suggestion tags, allows parameter customization, and streams synthesis status indicators.
Given generated draft completion, When inspecting the result, Then a tabbed preview shows formatted content, associated entity badges with clickable navigation, and active download triggers for DOCX, PDF, XLSX, and CSV with WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard operability.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Frontend document preview rendering and mobile layout adaptability
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero WCAG 2.1 AA violations and 100% interactive control state responsiveness

slices.title: Universal Document Agent Test Pyramid & Verification Suite
slices.jtbd: When verifying the autonomous document workflow agent for this epic, I want to execute unit tests for context aggregation and document parsers, integration tests for API endpoints and binary renderers, and end-to-end browser journey tests for document creation and entity binding, so that the entire workflow is robust against regression.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit test suites for prompt assembly, template-free parsing, and schema validation, When executed via automated runners, Then 100% of test cases pass with high branch coverage.
Given integration tests targeting multi-format export endpoints, When requests for DOCX, PDF, XLSX, and CSV are dispatched, Then valid HTTP 200 responses with correct binary MIME types and non-empty payloads are verified.
Given an end-to-end user journey test in Playwright, When an administrator requests an analytical memo, links it to a resident profile, and triggers export, Then the document appears in the entity card document registry and downloads successfully.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Continuous test execution speed and multi-format document verification coverage
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate across unit, integration, and E2E test pyramid layers
